units.relation: physical transformer matrices use V, A, and S while normalized voltage variables improve numerical scaling only

decisions.relation: tap identity and finite domain are unchanged; each tap-conditioned continuous optimum is compared before exact selection

constraints.relation: all nonlinear network constraints are unchanged after pointwise factor evaluation
target: the identical network and recovered transformer constraints

source: all winding terminal voltage and current phasors
boundary_quantities.relation: the parameterized factor is pointwise identical at every retained tap position

objectives.relation: the objective is evaluated on the same recovered network state

state_variables.relation: for each tap, source and target stamp the same complex terminal and lifted leakage-current maps into the network equations
target: currents recovered from the evaluated parameterized factor

preconditions: TR-XFMR-005 applies to the retained finite scalar tap domain
the source and target use identical slack, load, voltage, KCL, current-limit, and objective equations
the open delta tertiary has zero terminal injections and an explicit common-mode voltage gauge
each finite tap-conditioned continuous subproblem is solved to the recorded local optimum

provenance.coordinate_system: rectangular complex conductor voltages with physical transformer matrices and normalized voltage variables

detail.selection_method: exact enumeration of the finite declared tap domain

constraint_map.network_embedding: evaluate Y_complete(tap) and M_leakage(tap), then stamp unchanged phase-power, KCL, voltage, and current-limit constraints
constraint_map.discrete_selection: solve every declared tap-conditioned continuous subproblem and select the maximum served-load objective
constraint_map.frozen_start: tap=tap_start is a feasible-set restriction, not an exact replacement for the retained decision

recovery_map.terminal_voltage: U_source = U_target in the same qualified terminal order

typed_interfaces.attachment_rule: certificate-local interface labels are crosswalked to the checked typed state-space/unit vocabulary; unresolved labels remain explicit rather than being guessed
source_boundary_labels: all winding terminal voltage and current phasors
target_variable_labels: currents recovered from the evaluated parameterized factor

three_scenario_decision.interpretation: Exact enumeration of the declared three-scenario phase-selective tap-path domain; continuous scenario values are locally solved Ipopt results.

operation_limited_three_scenario_decisio.interpretation: Exact enumeration of the declared three-scenario phase-selective tap-path domain; continuous scenario values are locally solved Ipopt results.

unbalanced_switching_decision.interpretation: Exact enumeration of the declared unbalanced two-scenario tap-pair domain; continuous values are locally solved Ipopt results.

switching_decision.interpretation: Exact enumeration of the declared two-scenario tap-pair domain; each continuous scenario value is the locally solved Ipopt result for that tap.
